# tapectl stage

[All commands](README.md)

Stage snapshots for writing

```text
tapectl stage [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

**Subcommands**

- [`create`](#tapectl-stage-create) — Create staged slices (validate → dar → encrypt → checksums)
- [`list`](#tapectl-stage-list) — List stage sets
- [`info`](#tapectl-stage-info) — Show details for a stage set

### tapectl stage create

Create staged slices (validate → dar → encrypt → checksums)

```text
tapectl stage create [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

**Arguments**

- `<NAME>` — Unit name

### tapectl stage list

List stage sets

```text
tapectl stage list [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- `--status <STATUS>` — Filter by status (staging, staged, failed, cleaned)

### tapectl stage info

Show details for a stage set

```text
tapectl stage info [OPTIONS] --version <VERSION> <NAME>
```

**Arguments**

- `<NAME>` — Unit name
